profile.belief: I’ve always been drawn to the way entertainment brings people together and creates lasting emotional connections. What excites me most is the storytelling behind an artist or project and the opportunity to help that story reach the right audience. Through my experience in public relations and social media, I’ve discovered that I enjoy the strategy just as much as the creativity, whether that’s building campaigns, developing an artist’s brand, or finding unique ways to connect with fans. Working in the music industry, in particular, has shown me how much impact thoughtful marketing and PR can have on an artist’s career.
profile.working_on: My ultimate goal is to work in music public relations and artist marketing, helping artists build meaningful careers through strategic storytelling, branding, and fan engagement.
